title: Arts at Nine
author: Arts at Nine
description: Arts at Nine is Sudbury, Ontario’s premiere arts podcast. In our weekly episodes, co-hosts Judi Straughan and John McHenry highlight local artists of all disciplines and sit down for intimate conversations to learn more about them and their work. You’ll also hear music from local artists, and a chat with the owner of a local Sudbury business.
